name: latex-editor
description: Local-first LaTeX desktop editor powered by Electron, code-server and LaTeX Workshop

scripts.check: node --check src/main/config.js && node --check src/main/CodeServerManager.js && node --check src/main/WorkspaceManager.js && node --check src/main/LatexRuntimeManager.js && node --check src/main/ipc.js && node --check src/main/main.js && node --check src/preload/preload.js && node --check src/renderer/app.js
scripts.setup: npm run setup:code-server && npm run setup:latex-workshop && npm run check:latex
